author: Haer777
quote: I can’t for the life of me understand how this game is getting 10’s. It is The Sims. It’s not GTA. It’s Animal Crossing. Not GTA. I can’t help but feel reviewers were either paid for those scores or were afraid of being blackballed in the industry . It does look beautiful. But isn’t fun. You paint. Do chores. Assemble furniture. Get groceries. Get flowers. It must be that women made this game for other women. 0/10
